fact: The INSTAD Annuaire Statistique Edition 2023, cover dated 4th quarter 2024, publishes tables for years to 2022 sourced to the Direction Generale de la Population et de la Famille (births and deaths registered), Tribunal de Statut Personnel (marriages, divorces), prison administration, MENFOP education yearbook, CNSS, and customs declarations lodged with the customs revenue service.
title: Annuaire Statistique Edition 2023
